info.title: HaterPicks API (HaterAPI)
info.summary: Australian sports odds across every major bookmaker, as JSON.
info.description: The HaterPicks API returns live Australian sports-betting odds, merged and de-duplicated across Australian bookmakers. The Free plan covers game lines (head-to-head, totals and lines/spreads); Starter adds player props; Pro and Business add fair prices with edge %, arbitrage and same-game multi quotes. Plans: Free $0 AUD/month, 1,000 calls; Starter $29 AUD/month, 50,000 calls; Pro $79 AUD/month, 250,000 calls; Business $249 AUD/month, 1,000,000 calls. Every keyed response carries X-Quota-Limit, X-Quota-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset headers for the monthly allowance, and RateLimit-Policy / RateLimit (IETF draft) plus X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset for the per-minute limit; a 429 adds Retry-After. Versioning: the version is in the path (/api/v1) and v1 only ever adds fields, parameters and endpoints. A breaking change ships as /api/v2; the old version then sends Deprecation and Sunset headers and keeps answering for at least 6 months. Policy: https://www.haterpicks.app/api#versioning. Responses are gzipped when the client sends Accept-Encoding: gzip (use curl --compressed). HaterPicks is an analytics service, not a bookmaker: the API never places bets. Get a key at https://www.haterpicks.app/developer. Odds are decimal. Times are ISO 8601 UTC.

get.summary: List live odds across Australian bookmakers
get.description: Every live market HaterPicks tracks, one row per selection and line, with each bookmaker's current decimal price. Stale prices are dropped. On the free tier the rows are game lines only (`filtered: "game-lines-only"`); Starter and above add player props. Pass `sport` for one sport.

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Only rows for this sport: the rows' `sport` value, any case (AFL, NRL, NBL, NBA, NFL, SOCCER, RACING…). An off-season sport returns an empty list.

count.description: Number of items in `data`, on list feeds.

filtered.description: Set when the caller's tier trimmed the payload. The free tier returns `game-lines-only`.

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked API key.

403.description: The key's plan does not include this feed (`upgrade_required: true`, `required_tier` names the plan that does).

429.description: Per-minute limit exceeded (retry after the `Retry-After` header), or the monthly allowance is used up (`quota_exceeded: true`, `resets_at` is when it refills: 00:00 UTC on the 1st).

502.description: The upstream feed was unavailable. Safe to retry.

400.description: Body is not JSON, or the email is not valid.

429.description: Too many requests from this IP.

503.description: Could not record the request. Try again shortly.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Per-minute limit, IETF RateLimit header fields draft: `"minute";q=<requests>;w=60`.

RateLimit.description: What is left of the per-minute limit: `"minute";r=<remaining>;t=<seconds until a request frees up>`.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until a request frees up.

X-Quota-Limit.description: Calls the plan allows this month.

X-Quota-Reset.description: When the monthly allowance resets (ISO 8601, UTC).

bearerKey.description: Your HaterPicks API key (starts `hp_live_`) as a Bearer token.

headerKey.name: x-api-key
headerKey.description: Your HaterPicks API key (starts `hp_live_`) in the x-api-key header.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain English.

required_tier.description: The cheapest plan that includes the feed.

quota_exceeded.description: The monthly allowance is used up.

RateLimited.description: The Retry-After response header gives the wait in seconds.

BookmakerPrice.description: One bookmaker's decimal prices for a row. A bookmaker with no price is absent from `prices`.

sport.description: Sport code, upper case (for example `AFL`). The `sport` filter matches it.

player_or_team.description: The selection: a player on props, the home team on game lines.

line.description: The handicap or total. 0 on head-to-head.

EvOpportunity.description: One +EV player-prop price. Fields beyond these may be added within v1.

profit_pct.description: Guaranteed return as a percent of total stake.

legs.description: The selections to combine, each a player/team market, side and line.

books.description: Limit the quote to these bookmaker ids. Omit for every bookmaker.

auth.description: Whether the call needs an API key.
